exceptions.reason: No fixed release (<=4.0.7; the upstream fix micromatch/picomatch#194 is not merged). It comes only through the build and test tools tsup, vite and vitest (via tinyglobby and fdir), so no published package carries it (pnpm audit --prod finds nothing high). The only glob patterns those tools receive are the ones written in this repository's configs; nothing passes a pattern in from outside.
